name: KV Caching
question: Why does a long conversation eat your GPU memory?
problem: To write token 100, attention needs the keys and values of the 99 before it. Without a cache, the GPU recomputes all of them at every step.
points: Compute each token's key and value once and keep them in GPU memory.
Each new step computes only the new token's query.
The cache grows with prompt length and with the number of users, until it can take more memory than the model weights.
title: The Hidden Memory Bottleneck in LLMs: KV Caching Explained #shorts
